category_edits.rationale: Strengthen training-frequency attenuation across all four category models to reduce common-history-item dominance. Retain mean-one normalization, clipping, unseen and padding scales, and the existing checkpoint buffer restored by inference. Embeddings, HSTU topology, readout, loss and optimizer remain fixed.

response.change_summary: Change the training-only inverse-log-frequency exponent from -0.25 to -0.5 for all four datasets. Existing checkpoint loading preserves identical feature scales at inference.
